title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:

The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. Every position here is paper, and one trade says nothing about a strategy.

No exit is recorded for it in this snapshot. The market filter state is reported as off for both trend-daily engines. This article does not add a rule beyond the recorded state.

One trade says nothing about a strategy. The averages are reported as recorded; no further calculation is made here. A losing start is consistent with the stated expectation that losses were common in testing. The ATOM result is a single closed trade and is reported as a realized paper result. The rule was an entry after the daily close and an exit below the 10-day low; the measurement was -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip; the result was a loss.
